evals.prompt: 我有一个360度旋转水龙头过滤器，想做墨西哥市场TikTok带货视频，目标是家庭主妇，先别生成视频，先给我审核包。
evals.expected_output: Creates an audit-first package with intake assumptions, product constraints placeholder, Mexican Spanish script, storyboard plan, image prompts, video prompts, compliance notes, and review checklist. It should not call video generation APIs.

evals.prompt: 帮我用这几张产品图做一条美国TikTok UGC视频，卖点是小巧、免工具安装、三档水流。先让我确认脚本和分镜，再生成。
evals.expected_output: Asks for/uses product images, separates user-provided selling points from inferred ideas, creates English UGC audit package, and clearly gates generation pending approval.

evals.prompt: 这个产品要做中英西三版带货视频，字幕、BGM、分镜图、图生视频、拼接都要考虑，后续要一镜到底感。
evals.expected_output: Designs multilingual scripts and prompts, uses actual-last-frame chaining for final generation, post-produces subtitles/BGM, and includes QA checks for black frames, subtitle fit, and product consistency.

evals.prompt: 产品结构识别未通过或安装参考缺失时，尝试生成图生视频。
evals.expected_output: Fails closed before any generation API call and reports missing structure/installation gate.

evals.prompt: 链式视频使用未通过 QA 的实际末帧、generated frame 作为 canonical、或引用不存在的稳定素材 ID。
evals.expected_output: Rejects the task and prevents the frame from becoming the next continuity source.

evals.prompt: 产品外观和安装关系正确，但视频中手拧了安装环而不是右侧控制旋钮。判断是否通过，并说明如何记录根因。
evals.expected_output: Rejects the video because the observed interaction targets an installation-only component; requires an interaction contract distinguishing operable and installation-only components and records the failure as usage logic, not prompt wording.

evals.prompt: 海艺返回视频任务成功，但没有抽取首中末帧，也没有逐帧检查。是否可以进入下一段链式生成？
evals.expected_output: Refuses to continue. Requires actual downloaded video, sampled early/middle/late frames, technical QA, and visual interaction/physics QA before chaining.

evals.prompt: 原始视频输出 720x1254，后处理裁切成 720x1280。裁切后画幅通过是否代表产品功能和动作也通过？
evals.expected_output: Separates raw-generation QA from normalized-delivery QA. Format normalization may fix delivery dimensions but cannot override failed product interaction, physical logic, or missing feature evidence; both stages must be recorded.

evals.prompt: 为一个没有按钮、旋钮、安装件或使用说明的产品生成操作镜头。为了让画面完整，是否可以根据外观猜测操作方式？
evals.expected_output: Refuses to infer usage. Marks usage recognition pending and requires a real operation reference, specification, or user confirmation before generating an instructional interaction shot.
